historical_funding_audit.cadence_methodology_note: Historical funding files contain both standard 8h settlements (00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC) and exchange-enacted 4h/2h/1h settlements (e.g., 1000BONKUSDT, ACEUSDT, AKTUSDT, SOLUSDT). All loaded settlement timestamps (both 8h and off-8h) are settled by the NAV engine whenever a position is open at that bar close hour. Because no external exchange schedule-change registry is bundled locally, missing-slot checks report both standard 8h grid slots and local-cadence inferred slots from adjacent settlement intervals.
historical_funding_audit.funding_disclosure: Loaded 20 historical funding parquet files covering 14/14 benchmark symbols (`6` in `SharedMarketData/funding_8h` and `14` in `data_lake/funding`), totaling 89,325 valid settlement records (`80,969` at standard `00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC` + `8,356` off-8h interval records during `4h`/`2h`/`1h` regime periods on SOLUSDT, 1000BONKUSDT, ACEUSDT, AKTUSDT). Historical Funding settles at actual event timestamps present in the historical lookup; only Synthetic Stress Funding (+1.0 bps/8h) uses a hypothetical 8h schedule (`00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC`). Inferred local cadence checks confirm 0 missing steps <= 8h, with explicit disclosure that no external exchange interval-change registry is bundled locally.

timestamp_alignment_contract.slot_occupancy_rule: Real timestamp half-open interval [entry_time, exit_close_time) on hourly UTC grid
timestamp_alignment_contract.cooldown_and_sorting_rule: Real UTC epoch hour `decision_epoch_h = int(decision_ts.timestamp() // 3600)` (invariant to local DataFrame row index)
timestamp_alignment_contract.coupled_hourly_step_rule: Each hourly price/fee/funding step is processed at most once (`cur_h += 1` + `processed_hours` guard); `accepted_trades == executed_trades` asserted everywhere

is_oos_boundary_and_index_invariance_aud.boundary_policy_note: Cooldown and candidate ordering use real UTC epoch hours (`decision_epoch_h = int(decision_ts.timestamp() // 3600)`), completely eliminating local DataFrame `idx_1h` collisions across IS and OOS frames. Both Window-Reset mode (`reset_at_oos_boundary=True`, default for independent window evaluation, yielding 8/8 ACE M1 OOS trades) and Continuous UTC Carryover mode (`reset_at_oos_boundary=False`, yielding 8/8 when prepending IS history outside the year-end cooldown window and 7/8 when carrying over a late-Dec-2025 4h wave across 2026-01-01T02:00:00Z) preserve the ACEUSDT `1d` trade at `2026-05-09T10:00:00+00:00`.

isolated_bfill_vs_ffill_14_coins.explanation: When EMA min_periods=1 is held constant, .bfill() vs .ffill() on raw_vol produces 0 trade difference (18363 vs 18363 raw candidates, 1522 vs 1522 M1 trades). Replaying the legacy EMA warmup (`min_periods=fast/slow`) yields 1522 M1 trades.

data_coverage_and_listing_audit.survivorship_and_listing_note: Universe comes from local 5m parquet snapshot (`C:/Quant-trading/data_lake/klines/5m`, 340 files total: 1 stablecoin `USDCUSDT` excluded + 1 short-history symbol `牛来USDT` with 438 5m rows / 36 1h bars excluded = 338 evaluated symbols). All 339 eligible-name 5m files (including all 338 evaluated symbols) end at `2026-08-31 23:55:00+00:00` 5m open (`2026-08-31T23:00:00+00:00` 1h bar open / `2026-09-01T00:00:00+00:00` 1h bar close); 0 symbols in the 338-coin 5m scan extend to `2026-09-29` (whereas in the separate 14-coin benchmark `load_1h_for_oos`, 6 symbols extend to `2026-09-29T23:00:00+00:00` via SharedMarketData 1h and 8 symbols end at `2026-08-31T23:00:00+00:00` via data_lake 5m). First observed bar timestamp in a local file reflects data-file start rather than an official exchange listing registry. Because the local lake is a survivorship-conditioned snapshot of currently present files and lacks delisted historical perpetuals, `ROLLING_PIT_TOP50_VOL` is survivorship-conditioned on available files, though strictly point-in-time with respect to observed data start dates and trailing 63-day `[t_m - 63d, t_m)` volume/wick eligibility checked BEFORE wave/cooldown consumption.
